visual_plan: White model to materials and plants to layered PSD to Web comparison
narration_en_sample: In this tutorial, we will take one simple Rhino model through materials, planting, layered export, and AI postproduction.
narration_zh_sample: 本教程用一个简单的 Rhino 模型完成材质、种植、分层导出和 AI 后期。

visual_plan: Real GitHub EXE download followed by labelled installer illustration
narration_en_sample: Download the EXE installer from the SceneFlow Releases page. Save your work and close Rhino before installing.
narration_zh_sample: 从发布页下载 EXE 安装程序。安装前保存工作并关闭 Rhino。

visual_plan: Real settings environment check and original MCP connection settings
narration_en_sample: Check the environment and sign in for AI features. MCP connects compatible agents to Rhino; it is separate from AI account sign-in.
narration_zh_sample: 检查环境并完成 AI 登录。MCP 让兼容的 Agent 连接 Rhino；它与 AI 账号登录不同。

visual_plan: Highlight AI Materials Plants Plants List PSD and Web entries
narration_en_sample: Create assets, apply them to the model, export views, and refine the images in the Web Studio.
narration_zh_sample: 创建素材并应用到模型，再导出视图并在 Web 工作台完善图片。

visual_plan: Selected wall prompt reference library search generation object versus layer
narration_en_sample: Select an object and describe the material you need. Apply it to this object or to its layer.
narration_zh_sample: 选择物体并描述需要的材质，应用到物体本身或所在图层。

visual_plan: Close-up physical material dimensions and one scale correction
narration_en_sample: The texture represents a real-world area. Adjust its physical dimensions when the pattern appears too large or too small.
narration_zh_sample: 贴图对应真实世界的一块面积。纹理过大或过小时可以调整实际尺寸。

visual_plan: AI chat to library composition carrier density size seed and avoidance geometry
narration_en_sample: Choose a surface, adjust density and variation, and add geometry that the planting should avoid.
narration_zh_sample: 选择承载曲面，调整密度和随机变化，并添加避让物件。

visual_plan: Plants List isolated editing season and camera elevation-to-plan change
narration_en_sample: Open a planting group to edit an individual plant. Change seasonal variants and camera-dependent presentation.
narration_zh_sample: 打开组合编辑单株植物，再切换季节版本和随相机变化的显示方式。

topic_zh: 已命名视图与 PSD 导出
visual_plan: Save view sun output size channels inclusion versus eye visibility
narration_en_sample: Save a Named View, set the output size, and choose PSD channels. Exported channels can remain hidden when the PSD opens.
narration_zh_sample: 保存视图、设置尺寸并选择 PSD 通道。导出的通道也可在打开 PSD 时默认隐藏。

visual_plan: Actual PSD wood wall grass material children plus plants and shadow
narration_en_sample: The PSD contains separate editable layers. Materials, plants, and shadows remain available for further editing.
narration_zh_sample: PSD 包含可独立编辑的材质、植物和阴影图层，方便后续调整。

visual_plan: Send PSD to Web child layer participation brief update slider comparison
narration_en_sample: Create a child image, choose which layers participate, and review the whole-image render before high-resolution refinement.
narration_zh_sample: 创建子图、选择参与计算的图层，并在高清细化前确认整图效果。

visual_plan: Apply parent reference arrow text context boundary update and compare
narration_en_sample: Place references and annotations inside the context boundary, point to the target area, and update the image.
narration_zh_sample: 将参考图和标注放入考虑边界，用箭头指向目标区域，再更新图片。

visual_plan: Actual HD task shortened wait review save image and board aligned recap
narration_en_sample: Review the high-resolution result, export the finished image, and save the board so you can continue later.
narration_zh_sample: 检查高清结果，导出成品并保存画板，方便之后继续同一工作流。
